Title: Timing of presses and Press-step effects.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Shawn,

When exactly can press-step effects (like Pulled Fangs) be used?

1. Before any presses are announced.
2. After all presses are completed (neither minion presses or one of them
fails to respond to a press).
or
3. Any time during the press step.

For instance, could I withhold using Pulled Fangs until I was certain that
no new round would be begun (If I was wanting to used Growing Fury first,
for example, to burn the opposing vampire rather than just send him to
torpor).

Or could I use Fangs as a defensive measure (say, if a Tremere stole some
blood while I simply used hands for one damage, could I then wait until
the Tremere pressed before playing Fangs)?
--

Here's another Fangs question: What happens if you send an opposing vamp
to torpor before the press step? Can you then use PF to do an additional
aggravated damage? It seems as though you should be able to, but if
PF is played during presses, then the vamp goes to torpor before the
press stage.
